description: We are a dynamic three person team ; Imran, Poyraz, and Ozgun, participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. This is our first NASA Space Apps Challenge except our captain, Imran, this is his 2nd experience in NASA Space Apps. We are here to create a webpage about the story of a NASA Spacecraft. We all know each other for at least a year and we are a very confident team. We believe in our chemistry and skills. We are determined to do a useful project. We are all TED İzmir Highschool Students.
